profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Javascript, Java and front end leaning towards full stack. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from Tecnológico de Monterrey, Campus Guadalajara.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Working on web applications for internal use at Ooyala, on the front end side using AngularJS with Bootstrap and on the back end side using Go. Responsibilities include tasks such as deployment, design, bug fixing, feature additions and more.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Creating a web user interface for the Golden Gate database replication system.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Worked on internal applications for the Mexico Development Center:
- A parking system to manage and request for the highly demanded and limited parking space we had inside the building, it scaled out to several regions in Latin America as it was highly successful and made things much easier for the facilities team.
- Revamped MDC's engineering recruiting website where prospective candidates can check open projects and apply to them directly so the hiring manager gets notified directly instead of just applying to a general Software Engineer position as many other companies do.
- Among others.
Used APEX, HTML/Javascript/CSS.

honors.title: Student Development Diploma
honors.description: Award given to students that were heavily involved in one or several areas such as student groups, sports or cultural activities for at least 4 semesters.
honors.issuer: Issued by Tecnológico de Monterrey · Nov 2015

honors.title: 3rd Place Taller Vertical ISC Videogame Challenge
honors.description: Created a thrid person tower defense hybrid using Unity 3d and C#.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped students from an online high school with their informatics II course. They learned about programming basics and Microsoft Word basics.
